name: Stockade: Dextren Ward's Bladestorm hits its 4 yd circle and he roars after it (#7318)
contract: #7318: Dextren Ward's (1663) Bladestorm (2102554) triggers Whirlwind 2102555 every second with a 2 yd radius (radius index 7), while its visual draws a circle of about 4 yd (tester screenshot). For a creature caster the search adds no hitbox, so players inside the circle took no damage. coa_dungeon_spell_radius (new, read by CoADungeonBossSpellReach) sets the whirlwind to 4 yd (radius index 26). His Bellowing Roar (2102761) used the same 5-8 s / 20-22 s timer as Bladestorm, so the fear landed during the spin; it now follows each Bladestorm 6.5 s after it starts (the spin lasts 6 s).

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: Dextren's Bladestorm whirlwind (2102555) hits 4 yards around him
CONTROL: Dextren starts Bladestorm 5-8 s into the fight
DISCRIMINATING: no Bellowing Roar while he spins
still no Bellowing Roar 4.5 s into the Bladestorm
Bellowing Roar once the Bladestorm is over
